# #2660: Patch: Bots on ladder only concede less often
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

Bots on ladder only concede when there is lethal showing on board and they have no way to stop it. Applies to all bots, they may offer a draw if they think they are losing though.

### Acceptance

Lethal calculation is accurate, does not concede in places where there is not lethal
